Added PNG export for decks, including sideboards, native card artwork and optional statistics.

- **Copy as PNG** copies a deck image to the clipboard.
- Choose card quality, image resolution, Portrait/Square/Landscape format and background in **Settings → Mods → Deck image**.
- Show or hide deck name and class, normal crafting cost, mana curve, card types and rarities. Empty shields disappear, and uncraftable cards add no dust cost.
- Fixed dropdown text and selection backgrounds after native graphics-quality changes.
- Collection counters now include all equivalent reprint editions per quality.
- New export defaults: Normal cards, Medium resolution, Landscape and Native parchment. Existing settings are preserved.

### Downloads

- **BetterCollectionManager.dll**: standalone **BepInEx 5 Unity Mono** DLL for an existing BepInEx installation.
- **BetterCollectionManager-0.2.0-bepinex.zip**: BepInEx package with source, documentation and checksums.
- **BetterCollectionManager-0.2.0-shareable.zip**: MelonLoader package with source, documentation and checksums.

Use the build for your loader and run one loader variant at a time. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/blob/0.2.0/README.md#how-to-install).
